memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Rheumatoid arthritis, vitamin D deficiency, hypertension.
Symptoms: morning stiffness in hands >1 hour, fatigue, occasional joint swelling; blood pressure 148/92 mmHg; BMI 24. Examination: tender swollen MCP and PIP joints bilaterally, no lung crepitations. Labs ordered: ESR, CRP, RF, anti-CCP, LFT, serum 25‑OH‑vit D, calcium, phosphate, creatinine/eGFR, potassium.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: ESR 38 mm/hr (0‑20); CRP 12 mg/L (<5); RF positive 45 IU/mL (<14); anti‑CCP 210 U/mL (<20); LFT: ALT 28 U/L (≤35), AST 26 U/L (≤34), ALP 78 U/L (40‑129), bilirubin 0.9 mg/dL (0.2‑1.2). Serum 25‑OH‑vit D 14 ng/mL (30‑100); calcium 8.9 mg/dL (8.5‑10.5); phosphate 2.6 mg/dL (2.5‑4.5). Creatinine 0.9 mg/dL (0.5‑1.1), eGFR 78 mL/min/1.73m2 (>60); potassium 4.2 mmol/L (3.5‑5.0).

memories.text:
methotrexate 10 mg orally once weekly

Rheumatoid arthritis, vitamin D deficiency, hypertension.
Symptoms: reduced morning stiffness to 30 min, joint tenderness decreased; BP 132/84 mmHg. Examination: mild tenderness in wrists, no active synovitis. Lung fields clear. Inhaler technique not applicable. Advised to continue current meds, check labs.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Referral to Rheumatology, Dr. Priya Nair (MMC Rheumatology Centre) for evaluation of disease‑modifying therapy optimisation in rheumatoid arthritis. Patient currently on methotrexate, hydroxychloroquine, low‑dose prednisolone. Request advice on possible addition of sulfasalazine or biologic if needed.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Rheumatology review: disease activity low (DAS28‑CRP 2.1). Continue current regimen; add sulfasalazine 500 mg twice daily, increase to 1g BD after 2 weeks if tolerated. Monitor LFT. No biologic indicated at this time. Return to pulmonology for routine follow‑up.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Rheumatoid arthritis, vitamin D deficiency, hypertension.
Symptoms: joint discomfort mild, morning stiffness <10 min; BP 126/78 mmHg. Examination: no synovitis, lungs clear. Inhaler technique not applicable. Patient started sulfasalazine 500 mg BD two weeks ago, tolerating well. Plan: uptitrate sulfasalazine to 1g BD, continue other meds, repeat labs in 6 weeks.
